name: Shotamane Boku ga Manager ni Natta Wake
original_name: ショタマネ ぼくがマネージャーになった理由
source: Imai is a freshmen entering high school. Unknown to him the high school he joined is famous for being obsess with sports and athletic clubs. While not mandatory it is the accepted norm students join a sports club/team. Despite liking sports Imai is short and unathletic compared to avg person. Having trouble deciding what club to join he spends his next few days exploring them and finds him self mixing up with some famous and or strange women.
translation: 今井是一名进入高中的新生。他不知道的是，他就读的高中因痴迷体育和体育俱乐部而闻名。虽然不是强制性的，但学生加入体育俱乐部/团队是公认的规范。尽管喜欢运动，但与普通人相比，今井身材矮小，缺乏运动能力。由于难以决定加入哪个俱乐部，他在接下来的几天里探索了这些俱乐部，并发现自己与一些著名的和/或奇怪的女性混在一起。
